run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: A pure internal refactor addressing 13 SonarQube findings: decompose five overly-complex functions (and one test) into focused helpers, deduplicate the three backup-status notification titles behind one `backupStatusTitle` helper, remove a byte-identical duplicate GitLab test, and tidy the Dockerfile (merge RUN steps, sort apk packages, quote `${TAG}`). No behavior change is intended anywhere.
summary.issue_fit: No originating issue is linked; the single commit message (identical in substance to the PR body) is the only intent source. Every claimed extraction and cleanup is verified `met` against the diff.
summary.coverage: All 4 changed files (docker/Dockerfile, internal/backup.go, internal/backup_test.go, internal/notify.go) were read in full against the merge-base diff, cross-checked line-by-line against the pre-refactor code for every extracted helper. `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./internal/ -count=1` all ran clean at the reviewed head offline; the two provider-credentialed subtests skip for lack of credentials, matching the run policy. One concurrency safety premise on the extracted scheduler-shutdown helper was dispatched to a fresh-context verifier and ruled `holds`.
check_details: Reviewer ran `go build ./...` at head 136a4850d: exit 0, no output.
Reviewer ran `go vet ./...` at head 136a4850d: exit 0, no output.

Reviewer ran `go test ./internal/ -count=1` at head 136a4850d: `ok github.com/jonhadfield/soba/internal 5.147s`; a verbose rerun of the touched tests shows TestFormatIntervalDuration/TestFormatIntervalDurationAdditional pass and TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup/TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup skip for missing GITLAB_TOKEN/GITEA_TOKEN, matching the stated unavailable credentials.
The PR body's claim that `golangci-lint run` reports 0 issues was not independently checked: golangci-lint is not available in the offline sandbox.

observations.fact: Copilot's review comment on this PR flags the log text "Organistations" (internal/backup.go:207 in the PR diff); that misspelling is unchanged from the base branch, which already used it in the GitHub, Gitea, and Azure DevOps startup-config blocks — the new `logProviderOrgs` helper only relocates the existing text, so it is pre-existing, not introduced by this refactor.
observations.evidence: internal/backup.go (base c77f548) printed `"GitHub Organistations: %s"`, `"Gitea Organistations: %s"`, and `"Azure DevOps Organistations: %s"`; head's `logProviderOrgs(label, envVar)` (internal/backup.go) prints `"%s Organistations: %s"` with the same unchanged spelling.

observations.fact: Copilot's review comment flags `resetBackups()` running once inside each switch case and again unconditionally after the switch in the refactored `TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup`; that double-call structure is identical in the base branch's version of the same test (calling `resetBackups()` at the end of each case and once more after the switch, every loop iteration) and is only extracted into helper functions here, not changed.
observations.evidence: internal/backup_test.go (base c77f548, TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup): each `case` block ends with `resetBackups()`, followed by an unconditional `resetBackups()` after the switch, inside the same `for` loop; the head diff preserves this exact structure while moving the assertions into `assertGiteaOrgTwoOnlyBackedUp`/`assertGiteaAllOrgsBackedUp`.

requirements.source: commit-136a485/"Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig, checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged."
requirements.evidence: All five functions in internal/backup.go were traced against the base branch: runProviderBackups now delegates to collectProviderBackupResults (same provider checks, same order); displayStartupConfig delegates to five per-provider helpers using shared logProviderOrgs/logProviderBackupsToKeep/logProviderCompareMethod/logProviderBackupLFS helpers that reproduce every original log line verbatim, including the pre-existing 'Gitlab backup LFS' and 'Organistations' spellings; checkProvider delegates to checkJustTokenProvider/checkUserAndPasswordProvider with identical counting/error logic; Run delegates to logRequestTimeout/validateStartupConfig/createWorkingDir/scheduleBackups in the same order with the same error returns; checkProvidersDefined's Bitbucket branch now calls the extracted bitbucketAPITokenDefined/bitbucketOAuthDefined predicates with equivalent counting. go build, go vet, and go test ./internal/ all pass at head.

requirements.source: commit-136a485/"Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go)."
requirements.evidence: internal/notify.go adds titleBackupsSucceeded/titleBackupsErrors/titleBackupsFailed constants and a backupStatusTitle(succeeded, failed) function reproducing the original switch; sendTelegramMessage, sendNtfy, and sendSlackMessage each now call backupStatusTitle(...) in place of their own copy of the same three-way switch, with identical strings and case order.

requirements.source: commit-136a485/"Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers."
requirements.evidence: Reading the base branch's internal/backup_test.go confirmed TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (lines 569-591) was byte-for-byte identical to TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup (lines 550-567); a repository-wide search found no other reference to the removed name. TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup's per-case assertions are unchanged logic moved into assertGiteaOrgTwoOnlyBackedUp, assertGiteaAllOrgsBackedUp, and a shared dirHasEntryWithPrefix helper.

requirements.source: commit-136a485/"Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages, quote the TAG variable in the download URL."
